canonical_project: National Data Processing Center Complex at HPPs (government program)
owner: Government of Tajikistan (Ministry of Industry and New Technologies)
notes: In a 26 Nov 2025 interview with the newspaper Jumhuriyat, Minister of Industry and New Technologies Sherali Kabir said the government intends to create a large complex of data processing centers attached to the country's hydroelectric power stations, citing 98% green electricity generation and abundant water for cooling, and interest from large foreign AI companies. Part of the National AI Strategy (5% of GDP from AI by 2040). National-level announcement with no specific sites named; candidate HPP locations include Nurek (Khatlon), Rogun (districts of republican subordination) and Kayrakkum (Sughd). Recorded under Dushanbe as the seat of government.
